narrative_framework.name: Boardroom Eight-Stage Narrative Standard
narrative_framework.description: A guiding narrative structure that expands organically into 12 to 20+ slides depending on dataset depth and complexity.

stages.description: High-impact opening framing audited population size, baseline mean, completeness, and executive scope.
Empirical baseline, observation window, non-null accounting, and central tendency benchmark.
What went well: peak surge capacity, top-performing cohorts, and positive empirical signals. Expand into 1-3 slides for multiple findings.
What needs attention: performance dispersion, risk concentrations, and operational variance. Expand into 1-3 slides for multiple findings.
Industrial People Analytics and connected discovery. Generate dedicated slides for each available model: McKinsey 9-Box, Burnout Strain, Bradford Factor, and Relational Linkages.
Explicit boundaries separating established empirical facts from unmeasured variables, plus detailed categorical frequency distributions.
Actionable, phased initiatives and tactical execution governance (RACI ownership, SLA windows, risk mitigations).
Immutable cryptographic SHA-256 seal and record-level evidence ledger. Split across Part 1 and Part 2 if more than 6 findings.

slide_count_rules.rule: Do not compress rich findings into a single slide. Every distinct strength, risk area, industrial model, and roadmap phase should receive a dedicated, uncrowded slide.

content_rules.ground_truth: Every numerical claim must be derived from the provided evidence package.
content_rules.phrasing: State counts as 'X of Y records (Z%)'.
four_core_questions: How significant is it? (Magnitude, percentage, spread)
Where is it concentrated? (Top cohort, department, date)
Why does it matter? (Operational impact and priority)
